title: First Contact
description:
Welcome to the Hello Cat lab. A new operator account named `operator` was provisioned on a fictional training host. The instructor captured this simulated shell session:

```
$ whoami
operator
$ pwd
/home/operator
$ ls -la
total 20
drwxr-xr-x 2 operator operator 4096 Nov 11 09:00 .
drwxr-xr-x 3 root     root     4096 Nov 11 08:55 ..
-rw-r--r-- 1 operator operator  184 Nov 11 09:00 welcome.txt
$ cat welcome.txt
Welcome, operator.
Your first lab token is Base64-encoded below:
d2VsY29tZV9ob21l
```

This exercise only uses a fictional, isolated host. The goal is to practice reading a file from the terminal and decoding the token it contains.
objective: Decode the Base64 token from `welcome.txt` and submit it as HC{token}.

hints.text: The `cat` command prints the contents of a file to the terminal.
The string in `welcome.txt` is Base64; decode it to reveal the token.
